package.name: detect_pallet_3d_gazebo
package.description: Gazebo (classic 11, ROS Noetic) test bench for the Livox pallet detectors of detect_pallet_3d: a base_link rig with a Livox MID-360-like 3D LiDAR on a configurable mount (incl. roll / pitch), a pallet model, and an evaluator that scores pallet_front_frame / pallet_edge_frame in base_link against the pallet's true pose. run_tilt_matrix.sh checks that a tilted mount gives the same detection as the flat one.
